metadata.title: Print Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring printed output complies with data classification, handling, and disclosure requirements.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Print data classification mechanisms, policy engines, document labeling, and print-time data inspection controls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for enforcing data protection requirements when information is printed.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Print data protection assumes baseline print identity attribution and access control.

metadata.remarks: Print Data Protection defines trust properties required to ensure printing of sensitive information adheres to institutional data protection rules. This pattern addresses classification awareness, policy enforcement, and prevention of inappropriate physical disclosure.

components.title: Print Data Classification Awareness
components.description: Ensures printing workflows are aware of data classification and sensitivity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exposure of sensitive data due to lack of classification awareness during printing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data classification and access control applied prior to physical output.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printing of sensitive information is governed based on data classification.
Adaptive controls enforce restrictions based on content sensitivity.

components.title: Policy-Enforced Handling of Printed Data
components.description: Applies handling rules to printed output based on policy and data sensitivity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Improper expansion of access scope to sensitive printed materials.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to constrain inappropriate data handling.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define approved handling of printed data by classification.
Privileges to print sensitive data are restricted.

components.title: Print Output Labeling and Marking
components.description: Ensures printed materials carry appropriate sensitivity and handling markings.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unmarked sensitive output enabling silent physical dissemination.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Visible marking to reduce mishandling and unintended disclosure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printed output includes markings reflecting data sensitivity.

components.title: Print Data Protection Auditability
components.description: Provides visibility into policy-enforced printing of sensitive information.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to inappropriate printing of sensitive data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support oversight and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printing of sensitive data is logged.
Audit review supports detection of policy violations.
